title: Create Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
description:
Create docs/adr/ directory with ADRs for key NTM design decisions.

## ADRs to write

ADR-001: Supervisor daemon port allocation
- am gets 8765 (DefaultAgentMailURL hardcoded); cm gets 8200; supervisor checks availability and falls back to random

ADR-002: bd removed from supervisor — no daemon mode
- bd has no daemon mode; ntm beads daemon commands return clear error
- Correct pattern: 'bd sync' for manual sync

ADR-003: am serve-http subcommand
- am has serve-http and serve-stdio; NTM uses serve-http
- Health endpoint: /health/liveness (not /health)

ADR-004: cm dev wrapper vs compiled binary
- ~/.local/bin/cm runs source via bun (dev); dist/cass-memory is compiled (distribution)
- NTM supervisor uses whichever cm is on PATH

ADR-005: git remote split (fetch upstream, push fork)
- fetch from Dicklesworthstone/ntm; push to jonathan-kellerai/ntm

## Format: standard ADR template (Status, Context, Decision, Consequences)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] docs/adr/ directory with 5 ADR files
- [ ] README.md updated to link ADRs

title: Validate all documented command examples end-to-end
description:
Run every example command from README.md, AGENTS.md, command_palette.md against
the actual ntm binary to confirm flags exist and output matches documentation.

## Method
1. 'ntm <cmd> --help' for each documented command — verify all referenced flags appear
2. Run read-only example commands and compare output to described behavior
3. Log any mismatch: invented flag, wrong subcommand, missing feature

## Commands to validate
- ntm session start/list/stop/status
- ntm boot [session]
- ntm sat [session] [model]
- ntm bp [session] [prompt]
- ntm bpf [session] [file]
- ntm monitor [session]
- ntm serve [--port]
- ntm beads daemon start/stop/status/health/metrics

## Expected outcomes to document
- ntm beads daemon * → 'bd does not support daemon mode; use bd sync' (correct post-fix)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All non-beads-daemon commands verified working
- [ ] Beads daemon commands verified returning correct error
- [ ] README/AGENTS.md examples corrected where behavior differs
